scope: scripts/qualify_online_routes.py --skip-upload from commit 4963644 on one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN with simulation support and a global DB OnDb (Count : Int := 5), downloaded to a fresh owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 instance whose protection credential was provisioned, in RUN, logged in only as the instance's generated scratch runtime user: typed refusals that change nothing (unknown ticket, the CPU's protection credential, runtime-user metadata naming another project or CPU, a copy outside scratch-credentials, no credential, an upload into an open project, db_snapshot_capture of a DB without a stored snapshot with DbSnapshotUnavailable, db_snapshot_create without a ticket with PhysicalPlcRefused, db_snapshot_load_actual without acknowledgement); plc_online_compare identical in every row; Count set to 42 through PLCSIM, db_snapshot_create applied with checkpoint, compile and save (preview without a previous snapshot), db_snapshot_capture reviews Count = 42; Count set to 7, db_snapshot_load_actual applied without compile and save, and PLCSIM reads Count back as 42 after a tag-list refresh; each online session completed its cleanup in RUN with at most one project-user login and the project state stayed unchanged; change_restore of the create gives the pre-change state, whose DB again has no stored snapshot; then stop, power off, owned release and unchanged preexisting TIA processes.
limitations: plc_station_upload ran only as its ProjectIsolationRequired refusal (--skip-upload); its TLS trust in an empty Portal is implemented on another branch.
One global DB with one Int; arrays, structures, instance DBs, retain values and a DB that already had a snapshot are not exercised.

InterfaceSnapshot.Export needs ExportOptions.WithReadOnly: Snapshot and SnapshotDate are read-only attributes. A DB without a stored snapshot exports empty SnapshotValues dated 0001-01-01, which the worker refuses as DbSnapshotUnavailable.

Each export carries a new DocumentInfo/Created, so the capture's file hash never equals a fresh export; the load compares the InterfaceSnapshot element of a fresh export with the reviewed capture's retained file, bound by its hash.

After LoadSnapshotAsActualValues PLCSIM reports its old tag list NotUpToDate (-47); the readback refreshes it through sim_tags. No public V21 API reads actual values back; PLCSIM is the independent reader.

Provisioning the protection credential trusts the owned, empty CPU's certificate on first use (trustOwnedEmptyCpuCertificate); the online sessions answer TLS NonTrusted and TIA asked them none. TIA reuses an online login within the same Portal.
One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 instance on local Softbus; never a physical PLC.
